name: no-customers-found
description: When the NetSuite query returns no records the DataWeave 'otherwise' branch renders a single 'No customers found' row. The page is matched in document order (rows and cells may not be reordered); only whitespace between tags is free, since the exact indentation of DataWeave's XML writer isn't documented. bodies/no-customers.html is the readable form of the expected page.

source.reference: get-customer-list-from-netsuite/src/main/app/get-customer-list-from-netsuite.xml (flow get-customer-list-from-netsuiteFlow: expression-filter, netsuite:query, dw:transform-message, parse-template customer/index.html); src/main/resources/customer/index.html (DataWeave: line: ... unless (payload is :empty) otherwise { tr: { td: 'No customers found' } })

body.q: SELECT email,firstName,lastName FROM CUSTOMER WHERE lastName like 'Zz%' ORDER BY lastName ASC

expected.body:
~(?s)\s*\s*\s*\s*

\s*Netsuite\ Customer\ List\s*

\s*\s*\s*\s*\s*\s*\s*\s*\s*\s*
\s*\s*
\s*\s*\s*\s*\s*\s*
\s*Last\ Name\s*\s*First\ Name\s*\s*Email\s*
\s*No\ customers\ found\s*
\s*\s*\s*
